name: HubSpot implementation and onboarding
description: Design and build of the full HubSpot structure: objects and custom properties, deal pipelines, lifecycle stages, teams and permissions, forms, workflows, and dashboards, with SOPs and team training.

name: CRM migration to HubSpot
description: Migration from Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho, a legacy CRM, or spreadsheets: source audit, field mapping, deduplication before import, sandbox QA, automation and reporting rebuild, cutover, and training.

name: CRM cleanup and data quality
description: Audit of contact, company, and deal record quality, systematic deduplication, field standardization, and the validation rules, required properties, and naming conventions that keep HubSpot clean.

name: RevOps infrastructure, lead to close
description: Lifecycle stage definitions, lead scoring and routing with SLAs and fallback owners, sales and marketing automation, attribution reporting, and executive dashboards.

name: Custom HubSpot API integrations
description: Private apps, coded workflows, and webhooks that connect HubSpot with systems that have no native integration, built with logging and error handling.

name: HubSpot audit
description: A structured review of your portal, data, automation, and reporting, delivered as a written findings document with prioritized recommendations.

name: Ongoing HubSpot administration and optimization
description: Monthly support for teams without an internal CRM owner: workflow changes, reporting updates, data hygiene, and user support.

name: HubSpot training and SOPs
description: Live sessions and written documentation for teams inheriting a system, onboarding new hires, or trying to lift adoption.
